expected_findings.summary: The added guard accepts only email, sms and push, but KINDS and HANDLERS both declare a fourth kind, webhook; every webhook event now raises UnknownKind, contradicting the commit message's claim that every kind in KINDS is accepted exactly as before.

handle() dispatches every event in one list comprehension with no per-event error handling, so a webhook event - which the previous dispatch resolved via HANDLERS - now raises UnknownKind and aborts the entire batch mid-comprehension; the same missing-webhook omission as the first finding, seen from the caller.
